data.$description: DELTA data layer (ADR-19, FE-Tokens-01 v0.2). Owned by DELTA; values must match app/utils/mapState.ts until Analytics switches it to the generated module.

state.$description: Off-ramp value states of TR-076. A reported value takes its colour from data.ramp.

zero-confirmed.$description: Records in scope confirm the figure is zero.

dash.$description: SVG stroke-dasharray; 'none' draws a solid line

pattern.$description: Pattern drawn over the fill in the stroke colour

not-reported.$description: Records exist in scope but did not report this figure (TR-076). NOT the same as data.map.no-records: never merge the two, even if their values match.

dash.$description: SVG stroke-dasharray; 'none' draws a solid line

pattern.$description: Pattern drawn over the fill in the stroke colour

insufficient-reporting.$description: The aggregate rests on too little reporting (PD-04).

dash.$description: SVG stroke-dasharray; 'none' draws a solid line

pattern.$description: Pattern drawn over the fill in the stroke colour

not-applicable.$description: The measure does not apply to this area.

dash.$description: SVG stroke-dasharray; 'none' draws a solid line

pattern.$description: Pattern drawn over the fill in the stroke colour

dash.$description: SVG stroke-dasharray; 'none' draws a solid line

pattern.$description: Pattern drawn over the fill in the stroke colour

no-records.$description: No record at all is in scope for the area. NOT the same as data.state.not-reported (records in scope that reported nothing, TR-076): never merge the two, even if their values match.

area-boundary.$description: Line between shaded areas on both maps (Alex, 2026-10-16: one map look).

selected-outline.$description: Outline of the selected area (D-3D-1: depth carries no data).

plausibility-marker.$description: Outline for an area whose figure includes a record flagged for review (C30).

not-applied-note.$description: Note that a filter could not be applied to the map. Shares its border colour with data.map.plausibility-marker but means something else: never merge the two.

canvas.$description: Background behind both maps, the analytics dashboard (MapChart) and the geoportal (GeoMap): one map look, grey canvas with the white data.map.area-boundary between shaded areas (Alex, 2026-10-16). Gives the country context before the basemap loads.

country-outline.$description: The tenant's outer boundary (union of its level-1 areas), drawn over both maps in light grey (Alex, 2026-10-18). The lightest grey with 3:1 or more against the canvas, white and the lightest ramp class (WCAG 1.4.11).

area-label.$description: Area and country names on both maps in light grey (Alex, 2026-10-18): the lightest grey with 4.5:1 or more against the canvas, white and the lightest ramp class (WCAG 1.4.3), with a white halo over darker classes and the basemap.

ramp.$description: Five-step sequential ramps per measure family, light to dark. PROVISIONAL until V-3 and V-4 (brand and dark mode). The lightest class is never near-white, so it is never read as a confirmed zero.

events.$description: Also colours record-count maps today (measureFamily("records") returns "events").

flag.$description: Markers for records flagged for review (C30).

review-chip.$description: Chip naming a plausibility flag in tables and lists. Same meaning as data.map.plausibility-marker on maps.

chart.$description: Neutral ink for charts drawn outside Recharts, such as the geoportal dossier.

axis.$description: Axis lines and neutral chart ink; also the fallback bar colour, which should never show.

notice.$description: Notes that carry a data meaning.

provisional.$description: Banner for figures on the reviewer provisional basis: includes unpublished records, never public (AB-01). Not the same as a general warning (brand.warning-*) or a filter not applied (data.map.not-applied-note).

hazard.$description: Identity colours of the eight HIPs 2025 hazard types (hip_class), for chips, glyphs and legends (NFR-094: a hazard type is never a series colour). Categorical, not a ramp. Each is at least 3:1 against brand surface and surface-subtle (WCAG 1.4.11); a chip always shows the type name too, so colour is never the only signal (1.4.1).

icon.$description: Dashboard icons, same as data.dashboard.icon (Alex, 2026-10-18 palette trial). 3.31:1 on white, 3.05:1 on the dashboard tint (WCAG 1.4.11); the title beside each icon carries the meaning.

dashboard.$description: Main dashboard palette, energized and clean (Alex, 2026-10-18; a trial, may change). Surfaces, borders, icons and titles only, never data series.

accent.$description: Decorative accents only (1.8:1 on white): selected-state fills beside a text cue.

icon.$description: Dashboard icons: 3.31:1 on white, 3.05:1 on tint (WCAG 1.4.11).

ink.$description: Chart titles and subtitles, bold: 12.24:1 on white.

slate.$description: Grey-blue text for Features Coming Soon (Alex, 2026-10-19): 6.42:1 on the dashboard tint, 6.98:1 on white (WCAG 1.4.3).

canvas.$description: Analysis page background, so the page is not plain white (FE-Proposal-03, Alex 2026-10-19).

surface.$description: Layers on the canvas: view bar, rail, filter row, cards (FE-Proposal-03).

hover.$description: Hover border of buttons and filter controls, the same blue in every brand theme (Alex, 2026-10-20). 3.13:1 on white (WCAG 1.4.11); on the hover tint it is 2.88:1, and the fill change also marks hover.

sfm.$description: Sendai Framework Monitoring section palette, fresh and botanical (Alex, 2026-10-18; a trial, may change). Surfaces, borders, icons and titles only.

mark.$description: Decorative rules only: 2.63:1 on white is below 3:1, so never an icon or text.

ink.$description: Sendai titles, subtitles and icons: 8.73:1 on white.
